description.summary: Magic fang gives one natural weapon or unarmed strike of the subject a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls
description.value: Magic fang gives one natural weapon or unarmed strike of the subject a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls. The spell can affect a slam attack, fist, bite, or other natural weapon. The spell does not change an unarmed strike’s damage from nonlethal damage to lethal damage. Greater Magic Fang School enhancing; Level druid 3 CASTING Casting Time 1 standard action EFFECT Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) Target one living creature Duration 1 hour/level (D) Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless) DESCRIPTION This spell functions like magic fang , except that the enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls is +1 per four caster levels (maximum +5). This bonus does not allow a natural weapon or unarmed strike to bypass damage reduction aside from magic. Alternatively, you may imbue all of the creature’s natural weapons with a +1 enhancement bonus (regardless of your caster level).
